There are a few places in Finalize that could run exactly
4 tasks in parallel. This is a bit tricky to implement.
It would also caused nested OpenMP loops which might
end up with two few (if nesting disabled) or too many
threads. Bottom line, be very sure that this will speed up
the task before trying to implement this.
On Linux and Windows it is simpler to parallelize
because there is no block consolidation on read.
So it is ok to just use a single parallel loop with
the same number of threads for each operation.
Application might choose to multi-thread. In that case it must choose
